name: SolarWinds Engineer's Toolset
description_en:
SolarWinds Engineer's Toolset is a collection of more than 60 network utilities for troubleshooting, performance measurement and administration. Its Desktop and Web variants have separate documentation. This profile reviews selected workflows rather than demonstrating every bundled utility.

Start an evaluation by choosing the actual variant, the required utility and an authorized lab target. Review the operation and license requirements before using a diagnostic result to support a wider rollout. The documented examples below distinguish generated traffic, credential handling and post-evaluation activation.
description_zh:
SolarWinds Engineer’s Toolset 集合六十多种网络工具，用于排障、性能测量及管理。Desktop 和 Web 有独立文档。本档案核对选定流程，未逐一演示全部工具。

评估先选择实际版本、所需工具及获准实验目标。将诊断结果用于更广部署前，应核对操作与许可要求。下文的文档示例分别说明生成流量、凭据处理及试用后的激活。

core_features.explanation_en: Desktop tools provide network diagnostic, performance and bandwidth measurements.
core_features.explanation_zh: Desktop 工具提供网络诊断、性能及带宽测量。

core_features.explanation_en: WAN Killer adjusts generated traffic toward a selected circuit-bandwidth percentage.
core_features.explanation_zh: WAN Killer 将生成流量调整至指定线路带宽比例。

core_features.explanation_en: Toolset-specific SNMP credentials are distinct from platform credentials, with a documented fallback.
core_features.explanation_zh: Toolset 专用 SNMP 凭据与平台凭据不同，但存在文档说明的回退。

en: Compare a diagnostic tool’s results with known lab devices.
Evaluate bounded WAN load and the Web-tool credential fallback in an isolated environment.
zh: 将诊断结果与已知实验设备比较。
在隔离环境评估受限 WAN 负载及 Web 工具凭据回退。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Confirm Desktop/Web scope, trial dates and portal license access; choose an authorized lab target.
steps.zh: 确认 Desktop／Web 范围、试用日期及门户许可访问，选择获准实验目标。

steps.en: Inspect credentials before polling; measure accepted traffic and exercise Pause/Stop for load tests.
steps.zh: 轮询前检查凭据，负载测试中测量实际接收流量并验证 Pause／Stop。

items.en: WAN Killer can create significant traffic and remote services may reject its payload.
items.zh: WAN Killer 可产生显著流量，远端服务也可能拒绝载荷。

items.en: Web tools can use platform credentials when no Toolset-specific credentials exist.
items.zh: 没有 Toolset 专用凭据时，Web 工具可能使用平台凭据。

pricing.summary_en: The official product page offers a fully functional14-day evaluation and paid Buy/Quote routes. The Desktop guide requires a license key afterward. No numeric starting amount was rendered and checkout returned no readable offer; current price, term, user/device coverage and variant inclusions require a quote. The trial is not sustained free use.
pricing.summary_zh: 官方产品页提供十四天完整功能试用及购买／报价入口，Desktop 指南要求之后应用许可密钥。读取结果无数字起价，结算页也无可读报价；当前价格、期限、用户／设备范围及版本权益需报价确认，试用不属于长期免费。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.en: The administrator-guide entry separates Desktop and Web manuals. Desktop is a toolkit for local network diagnostics; Web credential operations occur through the SolarWinds Platform console. Confirm the installed variant and its corresponding guide before applying settings. Documentation for one variant does not establish an identical interface or entitlement for the other.
sections.zh: 管理指南入口区分 Desktop 与 Web。Desktop 面向本地网络诊断，Web 凭据操作经 SolarWinds Platform 控制台进行。应用设置前应核对已安装版本及对应指南，不能将一版文档视为另一版同样的界面或权益证明。

sections.title_en: Generated traffic is an active test
sections.title_zh: 生成流量属于主动测试
sections.en: WAN Killer accepts protocol, receiving port, circuit bandwidth, packet size and target load percentage. Port7 echo returns traffic and produces bidirectional load; port9 discard produces one-way load. A web server may reject or close a connection before random payload is sent. A configured target rate is not proof that the remote service accepted that rate.
sections.zh: WAN Killer 配置协议、接收端口、线路带宽、包大小及目标负载比例。端口 7 echo 返回流量，产生双向负载；端口 9 discard 对应单向负载。Web 服务器可能在发送随机载荷前拒绝或关闭连接，目标速率不证明远端服务实际接收同等流量。

sections.title_en: Observe the adjustment and stop path
sections.title_zh: 观察调整过程与停止路径
sections.en: The WAN Killer guide says adjustment to the Windows networking stack can take up to 30 seconds and continues while running. It provides Pause and Stop controls. Evaluate only on an authorized lab path, record actual receiving traffic and use the stop control before changing the test scope. No load generation was performed here.
sections.zh: WAN Killer 指南说明适应 Windows 网络栈可能需要三十秒，运行时持续调整，并提供 Pause、Stop。评估仅应使用获准实验路径，记录实际接收流量，改变测试范围前停止；本次未生成负载。

sections.en: Web-tool credentials are associated with a user and do not change other platform credentials. If none are defined, existing Observability Self-Hosted credentials are used. The documented community-string test does not save test-device details with the credential set. Verify the intended target and account context rather than assuming a successful test creates device inventory.
sections.zh: Web 工具凭据关联用户，不修改平台其他凭据；未定义时使用 Observability Self-Hosted 现有凭据。文档说明 community string 测试不会将测试设备详情保存在凭据集中。应核对目标与账户上下文，不能将测试成功等同于已建立设备清单。

sections.en: The product page grants a fully functional14-day evaluation. Continued Desktop use requires applying a license key from the Customer Portal. Online activation is supported when connected; disconnected installations use the documented offline activation route through the portal. Retain the license/account access plan before relying on a disconnected deployment.
sections.zh: 产品页提供十四天完整功能试用。继续使用 Desktop 需应用 Customer Portal 中的许可密钥；联网可在线激活，断网安装使用文档规定的门户离线激活流程。依赖断网部署前，应准备许可及账户访问方案。
